payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
condition.criteria: Assess the same jacket's front closure using corresponding visible areas in SOURCE and EDITED, and inspect any directly visible closure cues in EDITED independently of cross-image correspondence. Score concrete visible movement of the front panels toward each other as partial fulfillment when an opening remains; score full fulfillment only when visible evidence shows the panels meeting along the closure with no visible opening remaining. Do not infer closure or progress from turning, swinging, draping, or occlusion. If the closure is not sufficiently visible in EDITED and no direct cue establishes its state, leave fulfillment unresolved.
condition.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED. Judge the requested endpoint as a fully closed jacket, using corresponding visible portions where available and any directly visible closure cues in EDITED. Distinguish visible partial closure from no change; do not treat pose or obscuration as evidence of either. Use insufficient evidence when the closure state cannot be reliably determined.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: The closure is sufficiently visible to assess, and EDITED shows no concrete movement of the front panels toward closure relative to SOURCE, with no direct visible cue of closure progress.
condition.half_when: Visible closure evidence shows concrete movement of the front panels toward each other relative to SOURCE, but a visible opening remains. If the closure is obscured and no direct cue establishes progress, leave the score unresolved rather than assigning partial fulfillment.
condition.full_when: Visible evidence in EDITED shows the jacket’s front panels meeting along the closure, with no visible opening remaining along it; mere occlusion or draping does not establish this endpoint.
